text: Nurse Betsy Connell leaves snowy Ottawa for Saint Sebastian, a Caribbean sugar island, to care for Jessica Holland, a silent woman who [drifts through the plantation grounds at night|images|weather, sky and darkness]. Betsy falls for Jessica's husband Paul as the drums of the houmfort carry across the cane, and a stabbed Jessica [does not bleed|threat|the dead that rise]. Old resentments among the Holland family surface, and the houngan begins [drawing her with a small effigy|threat|witchcraft and cursed things] toward [the sea|images|water and drowning].
